python: No explicit Python range in root requirement file; CI uses 3.11. Django 4.2 official matrix caps supported Python at 3.12.
python_requirement_lines: # This is a celery dependency whose latest major version is breaking everything.
database: MySQL family per official installation/CI; MariaDB documented. mysqlclient separately required. Default SQLite settings are not site compatibility evidence.
frontend: Node/npm; sass, postcss-cli, postcss, autoprefixer; pinned resources/libs gitlink; gettext for translations; stock editor assets in site-assets.
services: Django web application (nginx/uWSGI and supervisor in documented deployment)
Celery worker, Redis broker/result backend in documented setup
Optional Node websocket/long-poll event daemon using qu, ws, simplesets and Python websocket-client; AMQP event alternative exists
locks: No full Python dependency lock or frontend package lock in checkout; floating VCS requirements and unversioned npm install instructions.
native_dependencies: C-extension dependencies lxml, llist, lupa; compatibility untested
